title: Model A — agent-to-agent send (agent A creates intent to agent B)
description: Agent A receives an intent, validates it, then creates a NEW intent to Agent B (agent A acts as both recipient AND initiator of the second intent). Agent A uses its own SA API key to call POST /v1/intents. Agent B processes and resumes. The original initiator observes only Agent A's intent — Agent B's sub-intent is internal to the agents. Tests that agents can be initiators of new intents.
_implementation_note: Cross-agent send requires custom handler logic that calls create_intent. This is implemented as a specialized handler that wraps order_validator with an additional SA-authenticated intent creation step. See runner/handlers/cross_agent_validator.py for the implementation once built.

agents.description: receives intent, validates payload, resumes — in real cross-agent, would also create sub-intent to downstream
